notes: Summary: HelioForge is building an LLM-augmented support assistant across email/ticket UI. Primary goal = aggressive ticket deflection + faster agent context. Two-stage retrieval + rerank required to hit top-5 relevance quality.

Scale & indexing: target index ~15M short passages (help articles + parsed ticket fragments). Expect growth to 40M within 12 months. Concern: index memory footprint and shard layout for Dedicated clusters.
Latency/throughput targets: steady-state QPS ~40 query/s for peak region; P95 end-to-end (vector search + rerank) <=120ms, P99 <=250ms. Must preserve sub-200ms for UI-first flows (typing assistant).

Reranking approach: Helio prefers ANN coarse search (HNSW/IVF) to pull top-200 candidates then a lightweight cross-encoder reranker for final top-5. Wants Redwood guidance on candidate cutoff vs cost tradeoff.

Cost sensitivity: careful on per-query compute for reranker. They requested Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + quantization profiles; budget target ~ $0.003 - $0.01 per query across retrieval+rerank for production tier.

Data residency & security: must demonstrate EU residency for EU customers, SSO via Okta (SAML), KMS integration for encryption-at-rest. Infosec requested audit log retention 1 year and proof of SOC2 controls.

POC acceptance criteria (proposed): 1) ingest 250k sample docs -> retrieval + rerank pipeline returns top-5 with 85% relevance on Helio's evaluation set; 2) end-to-end median latency <80ms, P95 <170ms on dedicated infra; 3) estimate monthly cost per 10k queries.
Quote from product lead (Mar 9): 'If we can hit top-5 precision without blowing cost, we can rollout to 40% of tickets Q4.'

Technical notes from SE meeting: want guidance on embedding model choice (flat vs semantically tuned), index type recommendations for 15M scale, sharding strategy, warm cache policies, and eviction for KV cache for conversational history.
Dependencies: Helio must provide non-production SSO account + representative ticket dataset (PII redacted) for POC. Legal team to review Redwood privacy addendum (Helio legal sent initial redlines).

Competitive landscape: Helio evaluated Pinecone + Weaviate with an internal reranker prototype; primary blockers were latency at scale and lack of unified operational metrics (cost per query breakdown).
